blocks.text: The camp of Davao City First District Rep. Paolo Duterte has asked the National Bureau of Investigation and its chief Melvin Matibag to inhibit from the probe into the claims of dismissed police officer Rodulfo Gracioso Jr. against members of the Duterte family.
